statement.to_be_said_elsewhere: PROPOSED LEVEL · 12.7 M · VYSHNEVSKYI & SHEVCHUK 2024 · THE TREES DEAD AND STANDING, THE WATER ROUND THEM AND THE BED'S HEIGHTS DRAWN OR INFERRED · DRAWN; and that the view under the water, its surface, its silt, the dead trees and the water's disturbance round them are drawn.

said_so: SPECULATIVE AND DRAWN: the water at the proposed level, its waves, murk and surface seen from below, the plants' dead state, and the water round the stems that pierce the surface. Nothing is observed and nothing is generated by an AI tool.

The surface is a sum of small wind waves with the dispersion of capillary-gravity waves (omega^2 = g k + (sigma/rho) k^3), so its pattern evolves instead of sliding; the wavelengths, directions, slopes and the drifting rougher patches are drawn, not measured. Its RMS slope matches v7's (v9's calm surface).

SNELL'S WINDOW IS NOT DRAWN: at this view almost all of the surface seen lies outside it, so in reality it would mirror the murk below and the tower would not show; the view up through it is kept as a drawn convention so the towers and the lit wires stay readable, with only a hint of the mirror at grazing angles.

The water round the stems is placed where the plants' own modelled stems cross the proposed level (v10's crossings); its sizes scale with each stem's radius; the current's direction is v7's drawn current.
The level is a proposal: 12.7 m Baltic (Vyshnevskyi & Shevchuk 2024, p. 286), 13.1 m in the scene. The bed's heights are inferred (scene3d/bed.py).
The sound is v9's method, made again on 9 November 2026 with the truer Hum's 330 kV voice: the synthesized line, muffled under water (drawn).
